the-story.text: Three readers are owed something here: the owner of the on-chain ticket, who needs the definitions to be the interface; an external consumer, who needs a leaf codec and a state datum frozen; and anyone who pulls main, who should never see a commit where the model and the simulator disagree.

why-it-is-one-pr.text: A Lean-only change cannot leave main green. The simulator is a hand-written transcription of the model, not a generated artifact, and it asserts the real manifests against copies pinned by digest. Measured: unmodified the simulator gate exits zero; after a Lean-only change of the kind this ticket must make, it exits one.

what-the-registry-is-in-one-paragraph.text: The trie answers two questions and nothing else: is this key known, and where in its life is it. Seven edges move a leaf, each an MPFS primitive applied to a state, each a delta over three token kinds.

requirements.text: Eleven requirements, from the alphabet through to the simulator and its pages.

r1-the-alphabet-interface-1.text: Leaf and State are the only leaf vocabulary. Value, incarnation, asset scope and reuse identity are removed, not renamed, because a rename would preserve a distinction the registry does not make.

r2-the-seven-edges-interface-2.text: Seven edges, each with its primitive, its from and to states, and its token delta. There is no free-form update: the only updates are the two state moves.

r3-the-refused-combinations.text: Nothing is born terminal, a booking is not undone into absence, nothing leaves terminal, a zero-request batch is refused, and any mint differing from the summed delta is refused. Each carries its own distinct reason.

r4-admission-interface-3.text: Each of the six tree edges needs an approval token minted under the pinned application policy. The read needs none. Nothing application-specific runs at fold time.

r5-the-read-interface-2.text: A read is verified against the root at its own position in the batch, not the batch's first or last root, and it leaves the leaf unchanged. Only a terminal read is admitted, so no attestation of a leaf that can still move is ever produced.

r6-token-custody-and-routing.text: Absent tokens go to the cage's own custody so a later fold can consume them without a signature; active and terminal tokens go to the output the request names.

r7-the-state-configuration.text: Eight fields. The consumer pin is gone and the representative policy becomes the active policy, joined by the absent and terminal policies.

r8-the-statements.text: Eleven statements, proved without any use of sorry, each with a given-when-then and one executable model observation.

r9-the-instances.text: The open application is the smallest instantiation and is proved first. Naming is the second, with its existing statements re-stated over the new model and their meaning preserved.

r10-the-model-bound-tooling-and-pages-sl.text: The model checker and the corpus generators are opened to the new identities. The discipline stays: exact identity matching, proved only from the standard axioms, and byte-for-byte corpus regeneration.

r11-the-simulator-and-its-pages-slice-b-.text: A separately authored transcription of the frozen interface: the seven edges and the read exposed, every illegal combination refused by name, and page counts equal to what actually replays.

decisions-this-ticket-freezes.text: Three items the interface leaves open are settled here, each with its derivation, and each reported so the epic owner and the operator can overrule before the on-chain ticket consumes it.

d-codec-the-three-state-leaf-codec-froze.text: The leaf is one byte: zero for absent, one for active, two for terminal. It is the smallest total encoding of a three-element alphabet and admits no application payload by construction. Naming-era leaf bytes stop being valid leaves, which is the intended break.

d-ada-where-the-absent-tokens-value-goes.text: The value held with a consumed absent token is paid to the output the consuming request names. Paying the folder would pay it twice and distort the fold market; retaining it would accumulate unbounded dust in cage custody.

d-self-whether-the-registry-refuses-inse.text: It does not. Witnessing absence is a tree change, and the interface governs it with the same sentence as every other edge, so the pinned policy decides and the model carries no special refusal.

rejection-behavior.text: Every refusal is observable as a distinct reason rather than a silent no-op, and each has a control that can produce it.

observable-success.text: From a clean checkout, the model check and the full continuous integration both exit zero, the axiom report is clean, the four mutants each break their law, and no page or profile mentions the previous alphabet.

non-goals.text: No on-chain code, no runner, no release, no upstream work, and no hand edit of a derived page to match without re-derivation.
